newsitem.title: SPAIN: Cableuropa says plans with U S West "undecided".
newsitem.headline: Cableuropa says plans with U S West "undecided".

text.p: A spokesman for Spanish cable television and telephone consortium Cableuropa said on Friday that its plans with U S West were "undecided as yet", retracting an earlier statement.

"The only relationship between U S West and Cableuropa is that they are both partners in CTC, a company which is carrying out pilot tests in Barcelona, but the future plans (for collaboration) are not yet decided," the spokesman said.
This contradicted the company's earlier statement that it was planning to expand the partnership.

In a telephone interview earlier on Friday, the spokesman had said, "Up to now Cableuropa had a very limited cooperation agreement with U S West to operate within the cable business in Barcelona, but from now on we will present joint cable bids in the auctions called by the Development Ministry in different Spanish regions."
Cableuropa had also said it immediately planned to develop cable ventures in the coastal cities of Bilbao, Valencia and Barcelona.
